title: D4 repeated-measurement translation interface matrix
purpose: Consolidate the already implemented D4 projector, remediated two-stage public interface, causal temporal composition and four-schedule shared-history fixtures before any stochastic schedule pilot.
scope: Deterministic interface fixtures only. No production history generation, decoder performance comparison, bootstrap, threshold, crossing or fault-tolerance claim.
gates: All D4 hidden-to-public report rows and the registered categorical herald channel are normalized; perfect and zero-noise limits reproduce their deterministic records.
The second public record is action-conditioned, full binary, support-checked against its own action, and rejects wrong-action binding.
Public charge action consumes no private relation, support, effective-string, truth or sentinel field.
Every online temporal state and causal prefix excludes future and truth-sidecar fields.
Immediate, fixed-delay, JIT and offline branches consume one immutable visible-history digest while only offline is explicitly noncausal.
The same two public policy modes complete across all four schedules under matched timing and information budgets.
Nontrivial winding is an unconditional ground-state-relative logical failure; private scoring cannot mutate or precede a completed public transition.
Deterministic replay preserves every public request, action, completion state and registered key relation.
acceptance: Every frozen hash and R6AF status matches; every gate group exits zero; no production histories, arm evaluations or performance samples are created.
stop_rule: Fail closed on the first provenance mismatch or any failed gate. Preserve the matrix result and keep stochastic history generation and schedule-performance sampling blocked.
compute_budget: At most eight deterministic pytest gate groups over existing fixtures; zero production histories and zero performance evaluations.
